text: ESTIMAND RULING: choose B. Propositional is a measured term only when both recall and source predicates are present. Entity is a measured term only when the recall supplies at least one specified participant; once specified, lack of a matching source participant remains an observed mismatch under the current source contract. When the prerequisite is absent, omit the term from both terms and eligible; do not insert a zero, missingTerms entry, imputedTerms entry, or separately priced 0.5 regularizer. Reason: these cases are undefined comparisons, not provider abstentions. Their current 0.5 values alter source-versus-external and leaf-versus-segment prices despite no observation. The wire already declares them ineligible; relabeling the existing constants as priors now would preserve an unlicensed estimator by changing its name. Semantic abstention is different: a possible comparison was attempted and unanswered, so its declared imputation and carrier remain. Numeric behavior and goldens are expected to move and must be reviewed as an estimand change. Courts must pin term membership, support, and total for: both predicates present match/mismatch; either predicate absent; specified participant match/mismatch; no specified participants. Keep source normalization/calibration and supportOf clamp policy outside this slice; do not compensate for removed constants elsewhere.
